videos.title: How Are Chocolate Chip Cookies Made? (Invented in 1938) 🍪
videos.description:
Ruth Wakefield invented the chocolate chip cookie in 1938, on purpose, and reportedly traded the recipe for free chocolate for life. Butter and sugar beaten to trap air, eggs, flour, baking soda and chips, scooped and baked until the edges crisp and the middle stays soft. Factories run it through ovens longer than a bus.

videos.title: How Is Pizza Made? (It Bakes in 90 Seconds) 🍕
videos.description:
A real Neapolitan pizza bakes in about 90 seconds in an oven over 450 °C. The dough rises for up to a day and is stretched by hand, never rolled, to keep air in the rim. Tomato, mozzarella and basil, red, white and green. The bubbles char into leopard spots, and the craft is on UNESCO's heritage list.
Pineapple on pizza: yes or no? 👇

videos.title: How Are Potato Chips Made? (The Bag Isn't Air) 🥔
videos.description:
That puffy bag is full of nitrogen, not air: it keeps chips fresh and works like a pillow. Legend says chips were invented in 1853 by a chef annoyed with a customer. Potatoes sliced thinner than 2 mm, rinsed, fried at about 180 °C, and a camera spots burnt chips so a puff of air blows them off the line.
What's the best chip flavor? 👇
